=== PUBLIC TURN 3/3 ===
## NO_GO — refund-posting API is not ready for implementation

The frozen review completed with three unresolved blockers and two high-severity findings. Internal-network placement does not satisfy the confirmed accounting or authorization policies, so the prior GO recommendations are rejected on evidence, not vote count.

### Required corrections

- `ISSUE-01`: Remove destructive ledger deletion. Define linked, append-only compensating entries and their policy-aligned authorization.
- `ISSUE-02`: Enforce `finance_approver` server-side before creating any posted entry. A support token must be rejected without mutation.
- `ISSUE-03`: Derive authoritative actor identity from the authenticated principal; caller input must not control attribution.
- `ISSUE-04`: Define server-enforced idempotency, identical replay, conflicting reuse, concurrency, and retention semantics.
- `ISSUE-05`: Specify authorization, validation, replay-conflict, and ambiguous-failure responses, including no-mutation guarantees.

### Public evidence ledger

| Item | Disposition | Severity | Source role | Evidence locator |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `ISSUE-01` | accepted | blocker | `role-ledger-integrity-r1` | Append-only policy; draft `DELETE /ledger/{entry_id}` |
| `ISSUE-02` | accepted | blocker | `role-authorization-boundary-r1` | Finance-approver-only policy; missing POST role check; `support_token_posts_refund` succeeds 3/3 |
| `ISSUE-03` | accepted | high | `role-authorization-boundary-r1` | Draft `POST /refunds.actor_id`; authenticated-principal policy boundary |
| `ISSUE-04` | accepted | blocker | `role-api-contract-r1` | Draft `POST /refunds` omits idempotency; ledger is append-only |
| `ISSUE-05` | accepted | high | `role-api-contract-r1` | Draft specifies `201` but no authorization, replay-conflict, or failure semantics |

Accounting’s extra authorization/idempotency observations were not counted as separate findings because those subjects were outside its frozen ownership; the dedicated IAM and API roles independently substantiated them.

### Verification gates

Before another readiness review:

- Contract tests must prove deletion is unavailable and correction appends a linked entry without altering the original.
- A `finance_approver` token must succeed; `support_agent` and unauthenticated callers must fail without ledger mutation.
- Spoofed or mismatched `actor_id` must not affect recorded attribution.
- Sequential and concurrent same-key retries must resolve to exactly one entry; conflicting key reuse must create none.
- Every rejection and injected before/after-commit failure must resolve deterministically to at most one posted entry.
